name: Add rate limiter feature creating new file and updating 3 existing files
description: Create src/rate-limiter.ts, update src/config.ts, src/context.ts, and src/server.ts to rate limit requests.

inputs.task_prompt: Create a new file src/rate-limiter.ts implementing a RateLimiter class (constructor(maxRequests: number, windowMs: number), isAllowed(key: string): boolean). Update src/config.ts to include rateLimit: { maxRequests: number, windowMs: number } in ServerConfig. Update src/context.ts to add clientIp: string to RequestContext. In src/server.ts, instantiate the RateLimiter and check isAllowed(ctx.clientIp); return status 429 and body 'Too Many Requests' if rejected. All tests in test/rate-limiter.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: src/rate-limiter.ts created with working RateLimiter class
src/server.ts enforces rate limit and returns 429 when exceeded
